fixed_findings.fix: Consumer-only verify_single_inventory validates manifest object coverage/count, safe source paths, streamed member SHA-256 and ZIP CRC, after resource preflight and before provider entry.
fixed_findings.impact: Single-package staging and standalone upload; sharded frozen verification unchanged. No observation that production packages were corrupted.
fixed_findings.acceptance: Unchanged frozen producer single package passes; wrong content/count, malformed JSON, missing/extra members, CRC and unsafe paths reject; re-bound bad staged single package rejected before identity.

fixed_findings.fact: Zero-size Git tree could satisfy the empty-byte local size check without proving blob type. Reproduced with mocked outputs and with actual isolated Git objects.
fixed_findings.root_cause: Empty read recovery checked Git object size but not type.
fixed_findings.fix: Require cat-file -t result blob before accepting zero-byte evidence.
fixed_findings.impact: Report-only empty-content fallback; confirmed absence and remote errors remain nonmatching/blocked. Frozen verifier code unchanged.
fixed_findings.acceptance: Actual zero-size tree rejects; actual empty blob accepts; 404 and unknown-failure regressions pass.
